in a talkative mood: Dad was in a talkative mood at dinner, telling us story after story about his school days.
爸爸晚餐時很想聊天的心情，一個接一個地跟我們講他學生時代的故事。
a talkative child: Amy is a talkative child who chats with everyone she meets, even strangers on the bus.
艾咪是個愛說話的孩子，她會跟遇到的每個人聊天，甚至是公車上的陌生人。
a tame ending: The movie started with exciting action scenes, but it had a tame ending that left many viewers bored.
這部電影以刺激的動作場面開場，但它平淡的結局讓許多觀眾覺得無聊。
a tame performance: After weeks of training, the team gave a tame performance, showing little energy or excitement on the field.
經過數週的訓練，球隊卻表現乏味，在場上幾乎沒有展現活力或激情。
tame animals: At the petting zoo, children can feed tame animals such as rabbits and goats that are not afraid of people.
在寵物動物園裡，孩子們可以餵兔子和山羊等不怕人的馴養動物。
pretty tame by comparison: Last year's horror movie was terrifying, so this new one seems pretty tame by comparison.
去年的恐怖片非常嚇人，所以這部新片相比之下相當平淡。
a tasty offer: The company made me a tasty offer: a higher salary, a free car, and six weeks of paid vacation.
那家公司給了我一個誘人的提議：更高的薪水、一輛免費的車，以及六週的帶薪假。
a tasty morsel of gossip: My aunt loves to share a tasty morsel of gossip about the neighbors whenever she visits us.
我阿姨每次來我們家，都喜歡分享一則關於鄰居的有趣八卦。
a tasty dish: My grandmother cooked a tasty dish of fried rice with shrimp, and everyone asked for a second bowl.
奶奶煮了一道美味的蝦仁炒飯，每個人都要了第二碗。
a technical problem: The concert started an hour late because of a technical problem with the speakers and lights.
演唱會因為喇叭和燈光的技術問題而晚了一小時開始。
technical support: When my laptop would not turn on, I called technical support, and they helped me fix it over the phone.
當我的筆電開不了機時，我打給技術支援，他們透過電話幫我修好了。
technical terms: The doctor explained my illness without using technical terms, the special words that only medical experts understand.
醫生解釋我的病情時沒有使用術語，也就是只有醫學專家才懂的專門用詞。
on a technicality: The criminal was set free on a technicality because the police had filled out the wrong form.
那名罪犯基於技術性細節被釋放，因為警方填錯了表格。
technical skills: Workers need technical skills, such as writing computer code and repairing machines, to get jobs in modern factories.
工人需要技術能力，例如撰寫電腦程式和修理機器，才能在現代工廠找到工作。
a technical foul: The basketball player got a technical foul for shouting angrily at the referee during the game.
那位籃球員因為比賽中對裁判生氣大吼而被判技術犯規。
technological advances: Technological advances such as smartphones and the Internet have completely changed the way we communicate.
智慧型手機和網路等科技進步已經徹底改變了我們溝通的方式。
technological change: Older workers sometimes find it hard to keep up with rapid technological change in the office.
年長的員工有時很難跟上辦公室裡快速的科技變革。
technological innovation: Taiwan's economy depends on technological innovation, especially in making new and faster computer chips.
台灣的經濟仰賴科技創新，尤其是在製造更新、更快的電腦晶片方面。
teenage years: During her teenage years, she argued with her parents a lot, but now they are very close.
在她的青少年時期，她常常和父母爭吵，但現在他們非常親近。
a teenage daughter: As the mother of a teenage daughter, she worries whenever her sixteen-year-old comes home late from parties.
身為一個青春期女兒的母親，每當她十六歲的女兒參加派對晚歸時，她都很擔心。
teenage pregnancy: Sex education in schools can help reduce teenage pregnancy among girls under the age of eighteen.
學校的性教育有助於減少十八歲以下女孩的青少年懷孕。
a temporary job: During summer vacation, I found a temporary job at a café, which will end when school starts again.
暑假期間，我在一家咖啡店找到一份臨時工作，開學時就會結束。
temporary accommodation: After the fire destroyed their home, the family stayed in temporary accommodation until a new apartment was ready.
火災燒毀他們的家之後，這家人住在臨時住所，直到新公寓準備好。
a temporary measure: Closing the road is only a temporary measure until the broken bridge is repaired next month.
封閉道路只是臨時措施，直到下個月壞掉的橋修好為止。
a temporary setback: Failing the first test was just a temporary setback; she studied harder and passed the next one easily.
第一次考試不及格只是暫時的挫折；她更用功讀書，輕鬆通過了下一次。
temporary relief: The medicine gives temporary relief from pain, but the headache usually comes back after a few hours.
這種藥能暫時緩解疼痛，但頭痛通常幾小時後又會回來。
on a temporary basis: She is working here on a temporary basis while our regular secretary is away on leave.
在我們的正職秘書請假期間，她暫時性地在這裡工作。
a tender age: He began playing the violin at a tender age, and he gave his first concert when he was only seven.
他在幼小的年紀就開始拉小提琴，而且年僅七歲就舉辦了第一場音樂會。
tender loving care: With a little tender loving care from our family, the sick puppy grew healthy and playful again.
在我們家人些許溫柔的呵護下，那隻生病的小狗又變得健康又活潑。
a tender subject: Money is a tender subject in our family, so we try not to talk about it at dinner.
錢在我們家是個敏感的話題，所以我們盡量不在晚餐時談論它。
tender meat: Slow cooking for three hours produces tender meat that is soft enough to cut with a fork.
慢燉三小時能做出嫩肉，軟到用叉子就能切開。
a tender spot: The doctor pressed gently on my knee and asked me to tell her when she found a tender spot.
醫生輕輕按壓我的膝蓋，要我在她按到痛點時告訴她。
put in a tender: Three construction companies put in a tender to build the new library, and the city chose the cheapest one.
三家營造公司投標興建新圖書館，市政府選擇了最便宜的那家。
legal tender: In Taiwan, the New Taiwan dollar is legal tender, so every shop must accept it for payment.
在台灣，新台幣是法定貨幣，所以每家商店都必須接受用它付款。
